# Security Policy

**Language / Bahasa:** [English](SECURITY.md) | [Bahasa Indonesia](SECURITY.id.md)

## Supported versions

Security fixes are currently made against the latest code on the main branch. There is no separate long-term-support release at this stage.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not publish exploitable details in a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting or Security Advisories feature for this repository when it is available. Include the affected commit, steps to reproduce, expected impact, and a possible mitigation if known.

Do not include passwords, access tokens, private keys, or personal information in a report. The maintainer will review the report and coordinate a fix before public disclosure when appropriate.
